Riley Park: Quick postmortem follow-up: eviction cascade last night. Hotfix held but we need owners, timelines, and a trimmed runbook for triage + escalation.
Maya Patel: I will own the runbook rewrite. Plan: one-page triage checklist, exact pasteable commands, PromQL snippets, and clear escalation thresholds. Target PR Fri EOD.
Diego Alvarez: I'll own alerting + early-detection automation. Proposal: two Prometheus alerts (eviction count per nodepool, and fallback-route usage). ETA next Wed.
Sienna Ko: I'll own remediation work (spike + sprint). Proposal: 48h spike for TTL & batch-cap matrix, then a 10-day sprint for autoscaler tuning and graceful degrade. Spike results due Thu EOD.
Riley Park: Good. Runbook should include the minimal diagnostic bundle we used and a one-click checklist for oncall. Example commands to paste: ```
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl -n inference describe pod $POD | egrep -i "evict|oom|pressure"
kubectl -n inference logs $POD -c inference --tail=250
curl -s localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache_hit_ratio
journalctl -u kubelet | grep -i evict --no-pager | tail -n 100
```
Maya Patel: Escalation thresholds I'm adding: page @sre-oncall when >=3 pods evicted from same pool within 10m; page @infra-lead if fallback route used >1x in 30m; open INF ticket if user error-rate >0.5% for 15m. I'll paste these verbatim.
Diego Alvarez: PromQL snippets to include: ```
sum(rate(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"}[5m])) by (node)
sum(increase(kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Failed"}[10m]))
```
Also alert rule drafts will be attached to the runbook PR so oncall can enable/disable quickly.
Sienna Ko: Spike plan: TTLs=[15s,30s,60s], batch_caps=[48,56,64]; load test Fri 09:00 PT. If candidate reduces evictions with <1% p99 cost, we propose it for sprint. I'll post results in INF-6777.
Infra Bot: Created INF-6777 "Eviction cascade: runbook, alerts, remediation" and assigned Sienna, Maya, Diego.
Maya Patel: Runbook PR checklist: triage steps, pasteable commands, PromQL, escalation thresholds, canned Slack templates, rollback recipe, and a short post-change validation (p99 latency, kv hit ratio, no evictions for 30m). PR target Fri EOD.
Diego Alvarez: After PR merges I'll add an automation that bundles diagnostics (logs + metrics) into a single gist for the incident thread. Alert drafts by next Wed.
Sienna Ko: Action items summary for INF-6777: 1) Runbook PR (Maya) by Fri EOD; 2) Spike + load tests (Sienna) Fri 09:00 PT; 3) Alert rules + synthetic (Diego) next Wed; 4) Sprint kickoff after spike.
Riley Park: Thanks team. I'll schedule a 15-min sync Fri 11:30 PT after load tests to decide sprint scope. :white_check_mark:
